text:
sara_ops: Kicking off IAD cluster bring-up (gamma pool). Quick perf + kernel sanity before handoff. Goal: validate driver/kernel/modules, check no Xid/dmesg issues, and gather p50/p95/p99 for small requests <seq64>. Starting checklist now.

deploy-bot: provisioner: iad-gamma pool provision complete. nodes=12 gpus=48 region=iad tag=gamma

mike_infra: @sara_ops solid. For sanity run: `uname -r`, `nvidia-smi -q | grep -E 'Driver Version|GPU Current Temp' -A1`, `modinfo nvidia | head -n 5`, and scan `dmesg | grep -i xid` — paste outputs. Also check `ethtool -k` and MTU on bond interfaces.

sara_ops: Running commands now, paste results: 
```
uname -r
5.15.0-108-generic

# nvidia-smi snippet
Driver Version: 525.85.12
GPU 0: A100-SXM4-40GB

# dmesg | grep -i xid
# no xid entries found
```

kai_ml: For perf runs use our internal harness: `runtest --mode=async --concurrency=32 --duration=120 --seq-len=64 --model=redwood-7b` — capture latency histogram and `nvidia-smi dmon` for util/mem. Also do a separate throughput sweep at concurrency 64/128 to find saturation point.

nora_sre: quick network reminder: ensure jumbo frames consistent (9000) across ToR and uplinks. Last time mismatch showed huge p95 spikes. Also confirm bond mode (802.3ad) and lacp active.

sara_ops: Ran async baseline (short run). Results:
```
runtest --concurrency=32 --duration=120 --seq-len=64
p50: 18ms
p95: 42ms
p99: 89ms
avg GPU util (dmon): 72%
no dmesg Xid or ECC errors
mtu: 9000 on all nodes
bond: bond0 (802.3ad) lacp active
kernel modules: nvidia 525.85.12, nvidia_uvm present
```

mike_infra: Good numbers — within expected delta vs prod-1. Two asks before handoff: 1) dump `lsmod | grep nvidia` and `cat /proc/cmdline` 2) run `ldconfig -p | grep libcudart` to ensure runtime libs resolve to packaged CUDA.

sara_ops: Posted outputs: 
```
lsmod | grep nvidia
nvidia_drm 57344 1
nvidia_uvm 832512 0
nvidia 1234567 42 nvidia_uvm,nvidia_drm

/proc/cmdline: BOOT_IMAGE=/vmlinuz root=/dev/sda1 rw quiet pci=nomsi

ldconfig -p | grep libcudart
libcudart.so.11.0 (libc6,x86-64) => /usr/local/cuda-11.0/lib64/libcudart.so.11.0
```

sara_ops: Handoff: assigning to @kai_ml for overnight quality evals (eval-subset run) and to @nora_sre for final network signoff. If both green, we'll tag this pool as `gamma-ready` and roll to staging. Run id: 1765432100-2 :thumbsup:

kai_ml: I'll kick off evals tonight, will report regressions if quality drift >2% vs baseline.

nora_sre: I'll do a quick sweep of ToR logs/flows and confirm. If anything pops, I'll flag here.

mike_infra: Thanks team — please keep this thread for any followups. If green, I'll add the cluster to capacity dashboard and enable autoscaler for gamma pool. :rocket:
